design.decision: Use the opening tricks to trump early or to shed a dangerous honor from a nil hand while others still follow suit.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first off-suit play; opponents lose their early [A]-[K] cashes.
design.rationale: The start of the round is where nil hands are most at risk and side-suit honors are cashed, so freedom there is useful in plain Spades; the rare last-three window measured poorly, and an early window may matter more.
design.draftText: Your team can play any suit on the first two tricks
design.hooks: anySuit gains a 'first: N' window (the first N tricks of a round) alongside 'last: N'; same follow-suit override, same rule about leading unbroken [♠]s

critic.concerns: Early trumping while still holding the led suit gives opponents little counterplay on tricks one and two.
